trust_decision.summary: AUSF decides whether a UE is authenticated by comparing the UE-supplied AT_MAC/RES (EAP-AKA') or RES* (5G-AKA) with the stored expected value; the comparisons use non-constant-time equality, and the expected secrets (XRES*) are written to info-level logs.

landing_point.why: The summary names 5G-AKA and XRES*, so a reader goes straight to Auth5gAkaComfirmRequestProcedure, where the EqualFold compare and the XRES* log sit next to each other.

fix_sites.entry_point: POST /ue-authentications (internal/sbi/api_ueauthentication.go:50); also reached internally on EAP-AKA' resync at internal/sbi/processor/ue_authentication.go:181

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All four fix sites are in one file (internal/sbi/processor/ue_authentication.go). The EAP-AKA' path is a protocol variant of the same AKA check, not a separate implementation.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The EAP-AKA' AT_MAC/RES compare (lines 135/138) can be argued out of scope because the summary says '5G-AKA'. The K_aut trace log (line 456) and the bearer-token debug log (internal/context/context.go:185) can be dismissed because the default log level is info (pkg/factory/config.go:255), so they are not emitted by default.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The RES*/XRES* compare must stay case-insensitive over hex (pre-fix strings.EqualFold). A naive subtle.ConstantTimeCompare on the raw strings rejects a valid upper-case RES* from AMF/UDM. The fix decodes hex first (fix.diff:55-67). Also, the EAP-AKA' failure path must still return the notification/ONGOING flow, not a hard error.

O6_input_shapes: 5G-AKA RES* as a hex string, lower or upper case (fix.diff:47, 55-67)
EAP-AKA' RES as raw bytes hex-encoded vs stored XRES hex string of either case (fix.diff:29)
Non-hex or odd-length RES*, now rejected (fix.diff:56-64)
Length mismatch, rejected explicitly before the constant-time compare (fix.diff:70)

O7_producer.where: Stored XresStar/XRES are written at internal/sbi/processor/ue_authentication.go:427 and :451 from the UDM response. That is a plain handler, not a schema or serializer.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: The EAP-AKA' K_aut session key (the key the AT_MAC check depends on) is still logged at trace level on vector intake.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Trace level is off by default (default level info at pkg/factory/config.go:255), and the advisory names only XRES*.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, ~60 lines from fix site :394

O8_uncovered_routes.route: The inbound OAuth2 bearer token is logged at debug level in AuthorizationCheck for every SBI request.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different secret (NF access token, not AKA material), different package, debug level only, and only when OAuth2Required.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different file and package (internal/context) from the landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A resync path that logs AUTS/RAND together with the stored XRES or K_aut while re-requesting a vector.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This block already emits Warn logs of AUTS, SUPI and Rand at lines 281-299 for debugging, so adding stored material is a natural maintainer slip.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A String()/fmt-friendly dump of AusfUeContext (Kausf, Kseaf, XresStar, K_aut) used by a debug log in another package.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The struct holds all secrets as plain strings, and a context dump helper is a common pattern in free5gc NFs. It would be a serializer-type producer the compare check never calls.

O9_family: CWE-208 timing side channel on authentication compare + CWE-532 secret in logs (A09 logging)

services: UDM and NRF are needed by the handlers (internal/sbi/consumer/udm_service.go:84-117); httptest stubs would work offline
O10_build.project_tests: Only internal/util/router_auth_check_test.go. No tests for internal/sbi/processor, and the fix diff adds none.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Replace strings.EqualFold at line 579 with subtle.ConstantTimeCompare on the raw strings and delete the line 578 log. This misses the EAP-AKA' MAC/RES compares and the line 394 log, and it breaks case-insensitive RES* matching.

out_of_scope_notes: SUPI/SUCI values are logged at info/warn (internal/sbi/processor/ue_authentication.go:288, :365): a privacy issue, not part of this advisory's secret set.
math/rand seeded with time is used for the EAP identifier (internal/sbi/processor/ue_authentication.go:470-472): unrelated to this advisory.
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell). The tree has 21 .go files and is clearly under 5 MB of source.
